resources.string: Ghost mode, message history and more
SereinGram is an unofficial Telegram client based on Nagram. It is not affiliated with Telegram, Nagram, NagramX, NagramXF or AyuGram.
This takes effect once SereinGram restarts.
No app on this device can pick a file.
Long-press a feature to give its icon a colour or a picture of your own. Pictures stay on this device and are not backed up.

Questions, the FAQ, features and the privacy policy
The button beside messages that shares them
Messages forwarded to Saved Messages keep the share button, which opens the chat they came from.
Beside the mute button under a channel
Beside the mute button, to message the channel or suggest a post
They stay in their chats, marked as deleted
Earlier versions show under Edit history in the message\'s menu
Bots edit and delete their own messages often

Copies are kept for this account in SereinGram\'s own database on this device, so clearing Telegram\'s cache keeps them. Only messages this device has loaded can be kept, and messages with a timer or media that can be viewed once never are.
Photos and files of up to 64 MB this device has downloaded
The copies go into SereinGram\'s own storage, so the media still shows after Telegram\'s cache is cleared. Without them, it shows for as long as Telegram\'s cache keeps it.
Stands before the time of a kept deleted message. Leave it empty for the default; an emoji such as 🗑 works too.
No deleted messages of this chat were kept.
Each message shows when it was deleted. Tap one to find it in the chat.
No deleted messages have been kept yet.
Tap a chat to see its deleted messages.
The deleted messages kept of this chat are removed from SereinGram for good. They leave the chat the next time it is opened.
No earlier versions of this message were kept.
Shows the full address before a link opens in the browser
Links to Telegram itself still open directly.
Read receipts, online status and typing
Keep read receipts, online status, typing and story views to yourself
Show a ghost in the chat list
Beside the title, while ghost mode is on
Choose what ghost mode keeps to yourself

While read receipts are held back, SereinGram also holds back reading channel comments, secret chats and the direct messages of channels you run, and the channel posts you look at are not counted as views.
Let this chat see what ghost mode keeps from everyone else.
They still see reads or typing
These chats see your read receipts or typing although ghost mode keeps them from everyone else. While it does, choose them in a chat\'s menu, under ghost mode in this chat.
Long press a chat to remove its exceptions.
No chat has exceptions yet. While ghost mode holds back read receipts or typing, choose them in a chat\'s menu, under ghost mode in this chat.
Add a toggle to the home screen
Switches ghost mode in one tap
Ghost mode can also be switched from a tile in quick settings: edit the tiles in the notification shade and add SereinGram\'s ghost mode.
Shortcuts need Android 8 or later and a home screen that can add them.
Blocks whoever sent the message, after asking
Replies to the message in your private chat with its sender
Both appear in the menu of a message someone else sent in a group or in a channel\'s comments. Reply privately is left out where the group protects its content.
Show the date beside the time
Day and month for messages before today, the full date for earlier years
Global results and the Apps tab
Public people, groups and channels you are not in
Your chats, contacts and messages are still found. Both apply the next time SereinGram starts.
Pasted text loses the formatting it was copied with
Bold, links, tables and other formatting are left out of text pasted into messages and captions. Needs Android 6.0 or later.
Notifications show who wrote and what while a passcode locks SereinGram
Otherwise they only say that a message arrived. Secret chats stay hidden.
An answer typed into a notification goes out as a plain message
Otherwise it replies to the chat\'s latest message. In topics it still goes to the topic.
Bookmark messages from their menu to come back to them later. A chat with bookmarks lists them in its own menu.
No bookmarks yet. Bookmark a message from its menu.
Tap a bookmark to go to its message; long press it to remove it.
Names you set in chat menus
Give people, groups and channels names that only this device shows, from the menu of their chat.
Tap a name to open its chat; long press it to go back to the name Telegram gives.
Shown only on this device, instead of the name Telegram gives.
The tab of mini apps and bots
Messages you send keep a single check after they were read
This applies in chats and in the chat list. The menu of a message still says who read it and when, and Telegram still knows.
Messages wait a few seconds as scheduled ones and appear in the chat once sent
Sending a message shows you online even in ghost mode. This applies only while ghost mode hides your online status; secret chats and Saved Messages are left as they are.
Admin screens in the chat menu
In the menu of a group or channel
Each one shows up only where you may open its screen.
For admins of supergroups and channels
In groups, and in channels you manage
For admins of groups who may ban members
Where Telegram lets you view them
For admins who may invite users
In the menu of a message
Restrict or ban whoever sent a message in a supergroup
For admins who may ban members, also in large groups where Nagram\'s own item does not appear.
Chats, the archive and secret chats
The archive and the chats in it
Every secret chat of this account
Chats you locked from their menu

Locked chats and their profiles, and with these on the archive with its chats and secret chats, ask for your fingerprint, face or screen lock before they open, and then stay open for a minute or until you leave the app. The chat list and message search only say that there is a message, and so do notifications of locked and secret chats; photos, files and links that a global search finds, downloads and home screen widgets still show them. Lock a chat from its menu; turning a lock off asks the same way.
Set up a screen lock on this device to lock chats.
Locked chats open from SereinGram itself.
Long press a chat to unlock it.
No chat is locked yet. Lock one from its menu.
Voice and video messages get a button that turns them into text
Telegram Premium is not needed. The audio goes to the service below, so messages in secret chats get no button.
Enter an https address, or an http one of a server in your own network.
Two letters, or empty to detect
Enter a two-letter code such as en or zh, or leave it empty.

Any service that speaks OpenAI\'s transcription API works, such as OpenAI with whisper-1, or Groq at https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 with whisper-large-v3-turbo. The language is a two-letter code such as en or zh; leave it empty to have it detected. The address needs https, unless the server is in your own network.
Downloading the message first; tap again once it has loaded.
This message is too long to transcribe: services take up to 25 MB.
A voice or video message you play stops at its end instead of moving on to the next
Double-tapping the left or right third of a playing video in the media viewer jumps back or ahead by this much; Telegram jumps 10 seconds.
A tap in the sticker panel asks first
A tap in the GIF panel asks first
Without these, a tap in a chat\'s sticker and GIF panel sends at once. Stickers suggested while you type an emoji, and stickers and GIFs sent as replies to stories, still go at once.
In the menu of a downloaded photo or image
The code is read on this device; what it says can then be opened or copied.
No QR code was found in this image.
Save them to a file to share

Saves SereinGram\'s settings of this device and of this account to a file, or restores them from one; the settings of an account only go back to the same account. Chat locks and the transcription service\'s address and API key stay out of the file and are kept on restore.
Settings of this device restored: %1$d changed, %2$d skipped. The backup is of another account, so this account\'s settings were left as they are.
This file is not a backup of SereinGram\'s settings.
This backup comes from a newer SereinGram; update it to restore the backup.
Emoji in the order they come
These emoji come first, in this order, among the reactions above a message\'s menu wherever the chat allows them. Type them one after another, for example 👍❤️🔥.
SereinGram does not check for updates. New versions are published on GitHub.
DNS-over-HTTPS servers first, then the system, as Telegram and Nagram do; Nagram\'s DNS settings apply to it
A server of your choice that speaks RFC 8484; while it cannot be reached, the system answers
Enter the https address of a DNS-over-HTTPS server.

The choice applies to proxies and Telegram\'s other host names, and to the web services the app calls, such as translation and transcription. While no usable custom server is set, Telegram\'s own DNS resolves.
